collection_label: Open research edition with recovered inputs
document_note: The monograph retains its historical results and now documents recovered catalogue and simulation inputs, executable cohort reconstruction and the completed frozen New Zealand refit. The repository is open to scientific review and revision.
release_note: Original regional data, explicit selection and projection rules, simulation histories and available fitted states are supplied with replay commands. Dated execution records distinguish raw-data reconstruction, model fitting and likelihood replay from source-hash and document checks.

historical_s04b_visual_review.scope: Historical S04B integration review; certifies its original pinned artifacts, not the current edition.

historical_s04b_publication_review.scope: Historical S04B integration review; certifies its original pinned artifacts, not the current edition.

review_scope: Internal computational and artifact review. No external academic acceptance is represented.

historical_editorial_visual_review.scope: Historical editorial remediation artifact review. Its original PDF and site hashes are retained; it does not certify the recovered-input edition.

current_edition_visual_review.scope: Internal production review of the current open research edition; exact artifact identities and declared visual/check scope.

status_meaning: accepted_final and completion_accepted are retained publication-builder state fields: installed production artifacts have passed internal checks. They do not represent scientific closure, journal acceptance or external peer review.
